_pcrs_comment: Every PCR this VM reported in its SHA-256 bank, from a signed vTPM quote. PCRs 0-7, 9 and 11 come from the firmware event log in fixtures/eventlog/, captured from the same boot, so replaying that log has to reproduce them. PCR 8 is here too but is not in the log: process-user-data extends it from userspace after the log is closed. PCR 10 is omitted because IMA keeps extending it as files are measured, so it has no settled value.
_initdata_comment: This VM was launched standalone with no peer-pod userdata, so process-user-data synthesised the initdata in fixtures/initdata/coco-dummy.toml. Its digest is what PCR 8 above was extended with.
